title: Beetroot Pachadi
description: Grated beetroot cooked lightly and folded into a coconut-yogurt base — a vividly coloured, mildly sweet Kerala side dish.
steps: In a pan, cook the grated beetroot with the water and salt over medium heat, covered, for 10-12 minutes until soft. Let any excess water evaporate, then set aside to cool slightly.
Grind the grated coconut, green chillies and cumin seeds with a splash of water into a smooth paste.
Mix the cooked beetroot with the coconut paste and whisked curd until well combined.
For the tempering, heat coconut oil in a small pan. Add mustard seeds and let them splutter, then add curry leaves and dried red chilli, letting them sizzle briefly.
Pour the tempering over the pachadi and mix gently. Serve at room temperature or chilled, alongside rice and curry.
